content.text: And God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good.

Look around. First, as a team, **agree on which way you are looking**: pick one view and point at it.

Then each of you, **alone and without talking it over**, writes down **5 nice things** you can see in that view.

When everyone is done, read the lists out loud. Every thing that at least two of you wrote down is worth **1 point**. If **absolutely everyone** wrote it down, it is worth **2 points**.

counter.label: How many points did you get?
counter.hint: 1 point if at least two match, 2 points if everyone matches
